source.original_text:
Attributed ASTIS background completion, not verbatim numbered paper theorem.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. The laws μ,J,ν are probabilities. There exists a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized density is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)), with Λ.IsCondKernel S and Λ.fst=Λ.snd=ν. There exists a bounded selfadjoint T on the actual real L²(ν) such that for every u, ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere, and ∫Tu dν=∫u dν. Its full scalar defect D=I−T² is positive. There exists a bounded positive REAL Γ with Γ²=D and for EVERY scalar u, ‖Γu‖²=‖u‖²−‖Tu‖². Probability, kernel, T, D positivity and Γ are conclusions; no supplied CFC/root/commutation or finite-dimensional L² certificate is assumed. For EVERY bounded positive REAL alternative Γprime on this SAME marginal whose square is this SAME D, Γprime=Γ. No energy identity is assumed for an alternative. This uniqueness quantifier lies outside the earlier every-u energy assertion. Printed joint/macro ΓP and B.11 still require SAME onto-M transport and the typed B*B identity, which remain separate.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
          Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) ∧
          (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖Γ u‖^2 = ‖u‖^2-‖T u‖^2) ∧
            ∀ Γ' : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              Γ'.IsPositive →
              Γ'*Γ' = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) → Γ'=Γ
decoder_context: The base is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including zero dimension. ContDiff order2 means C2; both displayed global Hessian inequalities and positive capped step are literal assumptions.

Measure.tilted denotes normalized exponential tilting. The displayed joint law is the independent-product Gaussian pushforward; second marginal, reflected pushforward, normalized Markov kernel/disintegration/stationary marginals are as displayed. They are produced conclusions.

Lp exponent2 denotes complete real AE square-integrable classes on the actual marginal, not a finite-dimensional space. The density equality holds at every state; conditional integral action is per observable almost everywhere.

Bounded real operator multiplication is composition. Positivity includes symmetry and nonnegative quadratic form. The scalar operator, positive defect and positive root with full energy are produced. Every bounded positive alternative on the SAME marginal with SAME square equals this root; no energy identity is assumed of an alternative. The alternative quantifier is outside the earlier every-observable energy conjunction.

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem actual_unique_positive_real_defect_root
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
          Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) ∧
          (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖Γ u‖^2 = ‖u‖^2-‖T u‖^2) ∧
            ∀ Γ' : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              Γ'.IsPositive →
              Γ'*Γ' = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) → Γ'=Γ := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,T,hTs,hAll,hD,Γ,hΓ,hΓSq,hEnergy⟩ :=
    RealDefectRoot.actual_positive_real_defect_root hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  refine ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,T,hTs,hAll,hD,Γ,hΓ,hΓSq,hEnergy,?_⟩
  intro Γ' hΓ' hΓ'Sq
  exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2RealSquareRootUnique.positive_square_roots_unique
    _ Γ' Γ hΓ' hΓ (hΓ'Sq.trans hΓSq.symm)

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.RealDefectRootUnique

reconstruction.text: Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its normed additive-group structure and its Borel measurable-space structure, including the case dim(E)=0. Let V:E->R be C2. Let alpha,beta be nonnegative real numbers and eta a real number. Assume alpha>0, alpha<=beta, eta>0, beta*eta<=1, and, for every x,v in E, alpha*||v||^2 <= D(DV)(x)[v][v] <= beta*||v||^2. Define mu as the normalized exponential tilt of canonical volume by -V. Define J as the pushforward of mu times the standard Gaussian on E under (a,z)->(a,a+sqrt(eta) z). Define nu as the second marginal of J. Define Lambda as the pushforward of J under (a,y)->(y,2a-y). Then mu,J,nu are probability measures. There exists a Markov kernel S:E->Measure(E) such that, for every y in E, S(y) is the normalized volume tilt with log weight x->-V((y+x)/2)-||y-x||^2/(8 eta); S is a conditional kernel for Lambda, and both marginals of Lambda equal nu. For this same S there exists a bounded continuous real-linear operator T on H=L^2(nu;R) such that T is selfadjoint; for every u in H, ||Tu||<=||u||, the function representing Tu equals y->integral u(x) S(y)(dx) for nu-almost every y, and integral Tu dnu=integral u dnu. The operator D=I-(T composed with T) is positive. There exists a bounded continuous real-linear positive operator Gamma:H->H such that Gamma composed with Gamma=D and, for every u in H, ||Gamma u||^2=||u||^2-||Tu||^2. Furthermore, for every bounded continuous real-linear operator Gamma' on this same H, positivity of Gamma' and Gamma' composed with Gamma'=D imply Gamma'=Gamma.
